parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

sub_parameters.name: FieldName
sub_parameters.description:
The query metric value.

> For specific dimensions, see [Data analytics field description](~~2878520~~).

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The time granularity for querying data. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of top data entries to query.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description:
The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

If this parameter is left empty, user-level data is queried.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.
